question: Identify the artist with the highest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order) and the artist with the lowest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order), then calculate the amount each customer spent specifically on those two artists’ albums. Next, compute the average spending for the customers who purchased from the top-selling artist and the average spending for the customers who purchased from the lowest-selling artist, and finally return the absolute difference between these two averages.
sql:
-- Verify with full details
WITH artist_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        a.Name AS ArtistName,
        a.ArtistId,
        SUM(ii.Quantity * ii.UnitPrice) AS TotalSales
    FROM artists a
    JOIN albums al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
    JOIN tracks t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
),
top_bottom AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1) AS TopArtistId,
        (SELECT ArtistName FROM artist_sales ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1) AS TopArtistName,
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1) AS BottomArtistId,
        (SELECT ArtistName FROM artist_sales ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1) AS BottomArtistName
),
customer_artist_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        i.CustomerId,
        tb.TopArtistId,
        tb.BottomArtistId,
        tb.TopArtistName,
        tb.BottomArtistName,
        a.ArtistId AS PurchaseArtistId,
        SUM(ii.Quantity * ii.UnitPrice) AS Spending
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN artists a ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    CROSS JOIN top_bottom tb
    WHERE a.ArtistId IN (tb.TopArtistId, tb.BottomArtistId)
    GROUP BY i.CustomerId, tb.TopArtistId, tb.BottomArtistId, tb.TopArtistName, tb.BottomArtistName, a.ArtistId
),
avg_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        PurchaseArtistId,
        AVG(Spending) AS AvgSpending
    FROM customer_artist_spending
    GROUP BY PurchaseArtistId
),
top_avg AS (
    SELECT AvgSpending FROM avg_spending WHERE PurchaseArtistId = (SELECT TopArtistId FROM top_bottom)
),
bottom_avg AS (
    SELECT AvgSpending FROM avg_spending WHERE PurchaseArtistId = (SELECT BottomArtistId FROM top_bottom)
),
tb_info AS (SELECT * FROM top_bottom)
SELECT 
    tb.TopArtistName,
    tb.BottomArtistName,
    t.AvgSpending AS TopArtistAvg,
    b.AvgSpending AS BottomArtistAvg,
    ABS(t.AvgSpending - b.AvgSpending) AS AbsoluteDifference
FROM top_avg t, bottom_avg b, tb_info tb
